d: Meicoomon rampages after witnessing Meiko Mochizuki being injured by the man bearing Gennai's likeness. "It would have been better if you hadn't been born..." Meicoomon disappears into the Real World, which has since become distorted. Possessing overwhelming power, she's the key to the world's destruction.
Upon arriving at the Digital World after the "reboot", the digidestined are hunted by a new villain. Meanwhile, Sora is troubled by her partner digimon's indifference towards her.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E3 - Challenge of the Masked Racer: Part 1
d: A masked racer, whose identity is in mystery, and whose face is concealed by a mask, came to Japan. He was a top racer but was also rumored to cause car crashes whenever he races.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E4 - Challenge of the Masked Racer: Part 2
d: Speed was saved by a masked racer who is revealed to be Speed's older brother, Rex Racer. When Speed was at Rex's house, he was mistaken for Rex and kidnapped by intruder.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E5 - The Secret Engine: Part 1
d: Speed tries to help a kind old man to find his stolen car. It turns out that the man is a son of a once infamous gang boss, and the classic car he drives has a map a stash of treasure.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E6 - The Secret Engine: Part 2
d: Speed and the old man are captured by Blaggard, the boss of a gang. Speed fights back against the thugs and discovers where the treasure is hidden and offers Blaggard a deal.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E7 - The Race Against the Mammoth Car: Part 1
d: Inspector Detector suspects that the criminals are mixed up in the No Limit World Race. It turns out the criminal are participating in the race on a Mammoth Car.

st: Speed Racer [English-Language Version]: S1 E8 - The Race Against the Mammoth Car: Part 2
d: Speed and Trixie learn that the Mammoth Car is the gold smugglers, but they fall into a trap. They are saved by a masked racer and pursue the Mammoth Car as it attempts to escape.
